entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There he is. It's Odo, the shop manager.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Odo Shadow spotted.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What an unpleasant smile.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's his customer service smile, right?[n]Yet behind the scenes, he's extorting[n]his subordinates.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This guy might start doin' it to his[n]customers, too. Who knows?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That would be a disaster! Let's go!

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: Welcome, welcome! How may I help[n]you, ladies and gents of the Phantom[n]Thieves?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why'd you blackmail your own[n]employees? That's not normal!

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: My shop is a directly managed store[n]of a large chain. Since I'm highly[n]competent, I'm in charge.

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I don't need strangers complaining[n]about how I use this shop's money.

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: Part-time workers are the property[n]of the shop. Thus, they are mine to[n]use as I will.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Property!? Who do you think you are!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I get it now. You pretend to be heroes,[n]but you're all just criminals. I'm gonna[n]kill you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go!

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I-I'm sorry! Am I really not worthy of[n]being the store manager...?
That's right.
At least you realize it.
You're fired.

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: *sob* I knew it...

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I'm a failure...

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I remember now... Employees aren't[n]property... They're human beings.

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: And yet, I took advantage of them.[n]I-I've done bad things...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Talk about a horrible workplace.

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I don't know how I can ever make up[n]for this...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You've done quite a bit more, haven't[n]you? It'd be best if you just confess[n]everything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Aren't those Chinese desserts[n]or somethin'?

entries.speaker: Shadow Odo
entries.en: I'm so sorrrryyyyyyy!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see. So he was lining his own pockets.
